lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I'm relieved.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Anyway, it's all fixed.
Nicely done.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I'm just glad

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I was able to repair it using the parts that I had gathered.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I don't feel as guilty now for having used it.
Haha, that's good.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: That's not to say my guilt is entirely gone, however.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I was the first one to use such a fine weapon which she had made.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: When I see her, I will apologize to her for this,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: and I'll also thank her.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: It's thanks to this fine weapon that

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: both Cinderella and I have remained safe until now.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: This is a truly well-crafted weapon.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I didn't even utilize it to its full capacity,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: but its power was incredible.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I can see why she is considered a specialist in this field.
It was that good?

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Indeed it was.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Her reputation truly precedes her.
Sounds like you and Snow White will have a lot to talk about when you meet.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: She might fight with Cinderella when they meet,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: but I will do my best to convince her that

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: it was all a misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I'll keep reasoning with her until she understands.
I'll pitch in with the explaining too.
I'll tell her that Cinderella is no longer Anachiro.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Truly.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: You've done so much for me.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I will repay you someday.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Whenever you need help, let me know.
I appreciate that.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: All right, I'll be in touch.
